headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential risks in npm and PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansion. Implement machine learning models for predictive risk assessment and user-friendly alerts.
actions: Add real-time scanning of package dependencies to identify security vulnerabilities before installation.
Implement a machine learning model to predict potential issues with npm/PyPI packages based on historical data.
Develop an alert system that notifies users about any risks associated with the packages they are about to install.
